mainEntity.name: Is Prompt Health's EMR software fully HIPAA compliant?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Prompt Health is fully HIPAA compliant, and patient data is protected across all workflows, roles, and integrations within the platform.

mainEntity.name: How difficult is it to switch EMR systems?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prompt's onboarding team manages most of the migration for you. Your role is to pull a set of reports from your current EMR and then Prompt handles the transfer from there. Clinics stay operational through the transition, and many teams choose to schedule below full capacity for the first few days after go-live, leaving room to work out questions early.

mainEntity.name: Is everything included in one monthly payment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Largely, yes. Prompt uses transparent, flat-rate per-provider pricing, and there are no hidden fees for essentials like reminders, digital intake, HEP delivery, or reporting. Home exercise programs (HEP) and the other essentials are included in your plan, not priced as add-ons. Some products and services sit outside the core plan, so book a demo for pricing tailored to your practice.

mainEntity.name: How does the onboarding process work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your dedicated onboarding team assists with setup, training, and data migration, timed around your go-live date so your clinic stays operational from day one. You get role-specific training sessions, video tutorials, and an ongoing success manager to get every role up to speed fast. The transition also involves a clearinghouse transfer with EDI and ERA enrollments, plus a secure data import of the data you provide from your current EMR.
